ASL Study Hall

Put it on your phone’s home screen

Add the icon (one time)

  1. Open this page in Safari.
  2. Tap Share at the bottom of the screen. Don’t see it? Tap ••• first.
  3. Tap Add to Home Screen. Don’t see it? Scroll down, or tap More •••.
  4. If you see Open as Web App, leave it turned on.
  5. Tap Add. The ASL Study Hall icon is now on your home screen.
  1. Open this page in Chrome.
  2. Tap the menu ⋮ at the top right.
  3. Tap Install app (it may say Add to Home screen).
  4. Tap Install (or Add). The ASL Study Hall icon is now on your home screen.

Then open ASL Study Hall from the icon. Students in the app creator’s classes sign in once with their school account.

Not in the class?

ASL Study Hall needs a school sign-in. Anyone can use these two apps, free:

🖐️ ASL Spellbound: fingerspelling →🔢 ASL NumberWise: numbers →See all the apps
